blocks.text: Experience gaming excellence with the ASUS ROG Strix G16, a powerhouse gaming laptop that combines cutting-edge performance with stunning visuals.The 16-inch FHD display delivers fluid gameplay at an impressive 165Hz refresh rate, while the AMD Ryzen 9 HX processor and 16GB RAM ensure seamless multitasking and responsive gaming.Equipped with the latest NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, this laptop handles demanding games with ease, offering ray-traced graphics and AI-enhanced performance.The 1TB SSD provides quick load times and ample storage for your gaming library.The Eclipse Grey design features ROG's advanced cooling system with vapor chamber and Tri-Fan technology, keeping performance optimal during intense gaming sessions.With its premium build quality, customizable RGB keyboard, and comprehensive connectivity options including Wi-Fi 6, this laptop stands ready to elevate your gaming experience.Whether you're competing online or creating content, the ROG Strix G16 delivers the power and precision needed for today's demanding applications.This computer is professionally upgraded by expert technicians. The seal is opened only to upgrade the components and perform testing. The product carries a 1-year manufacturer’s warranty. Feel free to contact us for support.Product Information:Model: ASUS ROG Strix G16 Gaming Laptop (2025 Model)Color: Eclipse GreyKey Features:Display: 16" WUXGA (1920 x 1200) IPS, Anti-glare, 165Hz Refresh Rate, 300 nits Brightness, 100% sRGBGraphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (12GB GDDR7, DLSS 4, Ray Tracing)Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX (16-core, 2.4GHz base, up to 5.2GHz boost)Memory: 16GB DDR5 (5600MHz), 2 slotsStorage: 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSDOperating System: Windows 11 HomeWireless: Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth (AX standard)Ports:2 x USB-C 4 (supports charging)2 x USB-A 3.21 x HDMI 2.11 x Ethernet1 x Headphone JackAdditional Features:Backlit Keyboard: Yes (RGB customizable)Customizable Case Lighting: YesCooling System: Air cooling for both CPU and GPUCamera: 1080p Front-Facing with MicrophoneAudio: Hi-Res Audio with Dolby Atmos, Two-Way AI Noise CancellationBattery & Power:4-cell Lithium-ion batteryDimensions & Weight:Height: 0.89"Width: 10.39"Depth: 13.94"Weight: 5.51 lbsSoftware Included:Armoury CrateMyASUSWarranty:1 Year Manufacturer’s Warranty
